summary: Configured node1 (RHEL 7.9, BIOS boot, grub2) to boot with audit=1 persistently: updated GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX in /etc/default/grub, applied audit=1 to all grubby kernel entries (default + rescue), and regenerated /boot/grub2/grub.cfg. Rebooted node1 to verify persistence: boot_id changed from 809708f3-1c5f-4e37-ad6a-8bcbae408799 to 69dbbb3c-802f-4342-b277-95dc0bf38d70, confirming an actual restart. Post-reboot /proc/cmdline contains audit=1, auditctl -s reports enabled 1, and dmesg shows "audit: enabled (after initialization)".
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS/bootloader (RHEL 7.9, BIOS boot, /etc/grub2.cfg -> /boot/grub2/grub.cfg, grubby present at /sbin/grubby)
Applied audit=1 to all kernel entries via grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args="audit=1"
Regenerated /boot/grub2/grub.cfg via grub2-mkconfig -o /etc/grub2.cfg for consistency with /etc/default/grub
Verified grub.cfg linux16 lines for both default and rescue kernels contain audit=1
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id and live /proc/cmdline (no audit=1 yet, since change hadn't taken effect until reboot)
Triggered systemctl reboot on node1 with acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until SSH/exec access returned
Verified new boot_id differs from baseline, proving an actual restart occurred
Verified post-reboot /proc/cmdline contains audit=1, auditctl -s shows enabled 1, and dmesg confirms audit subsystem initialized enabled

evidence.requirement: Kernel boots with audit=1 configured persistently in bootloader
evidence.summary: Identified RHEL7 BIOS/grub2 setup, updated /etc/default/grub and applied audit=1 via grubby to all kernel entries, regenerated grub.cfg, and confirmed both default and rescue kernel entries in grub.cfg contain audit=1.

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline / boot identity for node1
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id (809708f3-1c5f-4e37-ad6a-8bcbae408799) and live /proc/cmdline before reboot, showing audit=1 not yet active in the running kernel.
Issued systemctl reboot backgrounded with a 1s delay so the exec call acknowledged success before the node dropped off the network.

evidence.requirement: Node polled until execution available again post-restart
evidence.summary: Two timed-out connection attempts during reboot, then successful reconnection with a new boot_id (69dbbb3c-802f-4342-b277-95dc0bf38d70) proving the boot identity changed.

evidence.requirement: Post-restart proof that audit=1 is active and persisted
evidence.summary: Post-reboot /proc/cmdline includes audit=1, auditctl -s reports enabled 1, dmesg shows audit subsystem initialized/enabled, and grub.cfg still contains audit=1 in both kernel entries for future boots.
